Get Vantor Account Usage and Credit Overview

Source: R/vantor_seamlines_usage.R
vantor_get_usage.Rd

Queries the Vantor / Maxar Usage API (v2/activation/overview) to retrieve activation credit limits, total usage, and categorized consumption metrics. Useful for monitoring account quota in interactive R sessions or Shiny dashboards before launching large multi-tile downloads.

Usage

vantor_get_usage(
  category = c("PRODUCT", "DAY", "WEEK", "MONTH", "QUARTER"),
  unit = c("CREDIT", "FEATURE_COUNT", "REQUEST_COUNT", "MAP_VIEW", "GIGABYTE", "SQ_KM"),
  token = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

category

Character string. Grouping category for usage breakdown. One of "PRODUCT" (default), "DAY", "WEEK", "MONTH", or "QUARTER".

unit

Character string. Measurement unit for usage metrics. One of "CREDIT" (default), "FEATURE_COUNT", "REQUEST_COUNT", "MAP_VIEW", "GIGABYTE", or "SQ_KM".

token

Character string. Optional OAuth2 bearer token (access_token from get_maxar_token()). If NULL, resolved from the active OAuth2 session cache or VANTOR_USERNAME / VANTOR_PASSWORD environment variables.

verbose

Logical. Print summary messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

A list containing the parsed usage overview response (including activations, usageCategories, and a tidy summary_df data frame when available), or NULL invisibly if the API request fails.

Note

Authentication Requirement (OAuth2 Bearer Token Only): The Usage API (https://api.maxar.com/usage/v2/activation/overview) is part of the Vantor Account Services (Admin API) (https://developers.maxar.com/docs/admin/guides/usage). Per the Vantor API specification, API keys (maxar-api-key) are not accepted by Admin APIs. You must authenticate using an OAuth2 Bearer Token via vantor_auth(username = "...", password = "...") (or VANTOR_USERNAME and VANTOR_PASSWORD in .Renviron), and your account must have Admin permissions to view activation usage.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("VANTOR_USERNAME")) && nzchar(Sys.getenv("VANTOR_PASSWORD"))) {
  usage <- vantor_get_usage(category = "PRODUCT", unit = "CREDIT", verbose = FALSE)
}
# }
